The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: DNS ASIM parser for CrowdStrike Falcon Data Replicator
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
    let queryTypes = datatable(DnsQueryType: int, DnsQueryTypeName: string) [
        1, "A", 2, "NS", 5, "CNAME", 6, "SOA", 10, "NULL", 12, "PTR",
        13, "HINFO", 15, "MX", 16, "TXT", 17, "RP", 18, "AFSDB", 24, "SIG",
        25, "KEY", 28, "AAAA", 29, "LOC", 33, "SRV", 35, "NAPTR", 36, "KX",
        37, "CERT", 39, "DNAME", 41, "OPT", 43, "DS", 44, "SSHFP",
        45, "IPSECKEY", 46, "RRSIG", 47, "NSEC", 48, "DNSKEY",
        49, "DHCID", 50, "NSEC3", 51, "NSEC3PARAM", 52, "TLSA", 53, "SMIMEA",
        55, "HIP", 59, "CDS", 60, "CDNSKEY", 61, "OPENPGPKEY", 62, "CSYNC",
        63, "ZONEMD", 64, "SVCB", 65, "HTTPS", 99, "SPF", 108, "EUI48",
        109, "EUI64", 249, "TKEY", 250, "TSIG", 251, "IXFR", 252, "AXFR",
        253, "MAILB", 254, "MAILA", 255, "ANY", 256, "URI", 257, "CAA",
        258, "AVC", 259, "DOA", 260, "AMTRELAY"
    ];
    CrowdStrike_DNS_Events_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where event_simpleName in ("DnsRequest", "SuspiciousDnsRequest")
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(timestamp), TimeGenerated),
        DnsQuery = trim_end(@"\.+", DomainName),
        DnsQueryType = toint(RequestType),
        _QueryStatus = tolong(QueryStatus)
    | lookup kind=leftouter queryTypes on DnsQueryType
    | extend
        DnsQueryTypeName = case(
            isnotempty(DnsQueryTypeName), DnsQueryTypeName,
            DnsQueryType between (0 .. 65535), strcat("TYPE", DnsQueryType),
            ""),
        EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
        EventCount = toint(1),
        EventType = "Query",
        EventSubType = iff(isnotempty(QueryStatus) or isnotempty(IP4Records)
            or isnotempty(IP6Records) or isnotempty(CNAMERecords)
            or isnotempty(FirstIP4Record) or isnotempty(FirstIP6Record), "response", "request"),
        EventResult = case(_QueryStatus == 0, "Success",
            isnotnull(_QueryStatus), "Failure", "NA"),
        // Nonzero vendor statuses are not assumed to be DNS wire RCODEs.
        EventResultDetails = iff(_QueryStatus == 0, "NOERROR", "NA"),
        DnsResponseCode = iff(_QueryStatus == 0, toint(0), int(null)),
        DnsResponseName = trim(@";+", strcat_delim(";", IP4Records, IP6Records, CNAMERecords,
            FirstIP4Record, FirstIP6Record)),
        EventVendor = "CrowdStrike",
        EventProduct = "Falcon Data Replicator",
        EventSchema = "Dns",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventSeverity = iff(event_simpleName == "SuspiciousDnsRequest", "Low", "Informational"),
        EventUid = CrowdStrikeId,
        DvcOs = case(event_platform == "Win", "Windows", event_platform == "Lin", "Linux",
            event_platform == "Mac", "macOS", event_platform),
        DvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(aid), "Other", ""),
        SrcDvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(aid), "Other", ""),
        Dvc = coalesce(aid, aip),
        Src = aid,
        Dst = RespondingDnsServer,
        SrcUsernameType = case(isempty(UserName), "", UserName contains "\\", "Windows",
            UserName contains "@", "UPN", "Simple"),
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
        DstSystemEntityKey = "",
        SrcProcessEntityKey = "",
        SrcUserEntityKey = "",
        SrcUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
        // Preserve unverified fields rather than inventing normalized semantics.
        AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
                "ContextTimeStamp", ContextTimeStamp,
                "ConfigBuild", ConfigBuild,
                "ConfigStateHash", ConfigStateHash,
                "ContextProcessId", ContextProcessId,
                "ContextThreadId", ContextThreadId,
                "BoundingLimitCount", BoundingLimitCount,
                "BoundingLimitDuration", BoundingLimitDuration,
                "Entitlements", Entitlements,
                "EffectiveTransmissionClass", EffectiveTransmissionClass,
                "OciContainerId", OciContainerId,
                "TreeId", TreeId,
                "RequestType", RequestType,
                "IP4Records", IP4Records,
                "IP6Records", IP6Records,
                "CNAMERecords", CNAMERecords,
                "FirstIP4Record", FirstIP4Record,
                "FirstIP6Record", FirstIP6Record,
                "DnsRequestCount", DnsRequestCount,
                "DualRequest", DualRequest,
                "DnsResponseType", DnsResponseType,
                "EventOrigin", EventOrigin,
                "QueryStatus", QueryStatus,
                "OriginalAdditionalFields", AdditionalFields), dynamic({}))
    | project-rename
        EventOriginalType = event_simpleName,
        EventOriginalSubType = name,
        EventOriginalUid = CrowdStrikeId,
        EventOriginalResultDetails = QueryStatus,
        DvcIpAddr = aip,
        DvcId = aid,
        DvcScopeId = cid,
        SrcUsername = UserName,
        DvcInterface = InterfaceIndex,
        DstIpAddr = RespondingDnsServer
    | extend
        Domain = DnsQuery,
        DnsResponseCodeName = EventResultDetails,
        User = SrcUsername,
        SrcDvcId = DvcId,
        SrcDvcScopeId = DvcScopeId,
        DvcInterface = tostring(DvcInterface)
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount,
        EventType, EventSubType, EventResult, EventResultDetails, EventOriginalType,
        EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalUid, EventUid, EventOriginalResultDetails,
        EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventSeverity,
        Dvc, DvcIpAddr, DvcId, DvcIdType, DvcScopeId, DvcOs, DvcInterface,
        Src, SrcDvcId, SrcDvcIdType, SrcDvcScopeId, SrcUsername, SrcUsernameType, User,
        Dst, DstIpAddr, DnsQuery, Domain, DnsQueryType, DnsQueryTypeName,
        DnsResponseName, DnsResponseCode, DnsResponseCodeName,
        DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey, DstSystemEntityKey, SrcProcessEntityKey,
        SrcUserEntityKey, SrcUserAdditionalIds, AdditionalEntities, AdditionalFields
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
